thread:
maria: Getting reports of blank/errored graphs on the Console for multiple customers (started ~12:32 UTC). Panels are returning 500s from the analytics API. Example trace id: trace=abc123def — anyone already on this?
kevin: Yep, seeing a big spike in 500s across analytics-gateway. Logs show `upstream response timed out` and a bunch of `queue full` messages from analytics-worker.
sasha: Customer S-4123 escalated via support: dashboard widgets empty across orgs, reported after recent aggregator update. They've attached a screenshot and repro steps. Marked P2 for now.
olivia: I grabbed a curl sample and network trace. GET /api/v1/analytics/query -> 500. Response body: `{
  "error": "query execution timed out",
  "span_id": "abc123def"
}`. Happened at 12:34:11 UTC.
kevin: Quick repro I ran locally: open dashboard -> set range to 1h -> refresh -> request to /api/v1/analytics/query returns 500 intermittently. Network shows long TTFB then 500. Backend stack: aggregator-v2 -> analytics-worker -> clickhouse (timeouts).
maria: Can we toggle the canary back to v1 aggregator? v2 was rolled out to 10% this morning. If this is caused by v2 batching change we should rollback the canary immediately.
infra-bot: deploybot: rollback request received for service=aggregator, from=maria, target=aggregator-v1-canary (id: deploy-20240305-0912). Initiating.
kevin: Rolling back now. I see a backlog of ~8k queued queries on aggregator-v2 instances. Rolling v2 down should drain and restore capacity.
olivia: After initiating rollback (12:44 UTC) I refreshed the dashboard and widgets started returning 200s but slower. Customers on S-4123 just confirmed graphs are visible again.
sasha: Workaround noted in ticket: switch dashboard to shorter time windows (15m) until we finish the RCA.
maria: Root cause hypothesis: v2 introduced a batching/aggregation change that increases head-of-line blocking for long-range queries, causing the request queue to saturate. Will file an incident and assign eng-runtime + eng-ml to investigate kernel/aggregation behavior.
kevin: Filing incident INC-2024-58, adding logs, traces, and a sampling of failed query payloads. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml.
infra-bot: health-check: aggregator pods healthy after rollback, queue depth decreased to ~200.
olivia: Captured minimal repro and stack trace and uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood.example/incident/INC-2024-58/artifacts. Added suggested mitigation: lower default batch window to 50ms for aggregator v2 until fix.
maria: Thanks all — updating support ticket S-4123 with incident link and customer note. We'll keep the canary paused until an end-to-end test proves no regressions.
kevin: Next steps: eng-runtime to instrument KV cache and queue metrics, eng-ml to review batching change rationale, and ops to prepare a patch for v2 that respects long-query isolation.
sasha: I'll follow up with the customer in 30m with status.
maria: Closing thread here — incident created and rollback completed. If anything else pops up ping this thread. :thumbsup:
